target.title: fix(oauth): pass workspace context to resolveProviderIdForAuth on refresh failure
target.body:
> [!NOTE]
> **AI-Assisted Contribution:** This PR was prepared and validated with the assistance of the Antigravity AI coding assistant (Gemini 3.5 Flash).

## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a problem where the aliased provider lookup fails to resolve workspace-scoped aliases on OAuth token refresh failures.

**Symptom/Behavior:**
When clearing the last good profile on OAuth refresh failures, the aliased provider ID is resolved using the global context instead of the workspace-specific configuration. Specifically, `resolveProviderIdForAuth(cred.provider)` is called with only one argument, omitting the configuration and workspace directory parameters. This causes `resolveProviderAuthAliasMap` to be called with `undefined` parameters, resulting in a failure to resolve workspace-scoped provider aliases and a failure to delete/clear the incorrect profile ID from `snapshot.lastGood`.

Affected location: `[src/agents/auth-profiles/oauth.ts](file://src/agents/auth-profiles/oauth.ts#L472-L475)` (compiled as `dist/oauth-R_OaG_Ep.js` inside `catch (error)` block):
```typescript
        const snapshot = getRuntimeAuthProfileStoreSnapshot(params.agentDir);
        const providerKey = resolveProviderIdForAuth(cred.provider);
        if (snapshot?.lastGood?.[providerKey] === profileId) {
```

## Why This Change Was Made

Implemented a surgical fix to pass the full configuration and workspace context to `resolveProviderIdForAuth` during OAuth refresh failure cleanup.

**Solution Overview:**
1. Update `resolveApiKeyForProfile` to accept an optional `workspaceDir` parameter.
2. Pass the full parameters (context/config) to `resolveProviderIdForAuth`:
   ```typescript
   const providerKey = resolveProviderIdForAuth(cred.provider, {
     config: cfg,
     workspaceDir: params.workspaceDir,
   });
   ```
3. Thread the `workspaceDir` context through all calling paths (including `src/agents/cli-runner/prepare.ts`, `src/agents/model-auth.ts`, and `src/plugin-sdk/provider-auth.ts`).

---

## User Impact

Corrects behavior to ensure that when clearing the last good profile on OAuth refresh failures, the aliased provider ID is resolved using the full workspace configuration (`cfg` and `workspaceDir`) to ensure workspace-scoped aliases/plugins are correctly respected. This prevents stale/broken credentials from sticking around as `lastGood` in workspaces using scoped aliases.

---

## Evidence

### Unit Tests / Verification Suite
- Staged and verified multi-scenario reproduction test suites covering happy path, edge cases, and stress/concurrency scenarios:
  - Happy Path: `[src/agents/auth-profiles/repro_1_4_happy.test.ts](file://src/agents/auth-profiles/repro_1_4_happy.test.ts)` — verifies standard correct OAuth refresh under workspace alias mapping.
  - Edge Cases: `[src/agents/auth-profiles/repro_1_4_edge.test.ts](file://src/agents/auth-profiles/repro_1_4_edge.test.ts)` — verifies clearing of lastGood on refresh failure when workspaceDir is present, and verifies that it is NOT cleared when workspaceDir is missing.
  - Stress & Concurrency: `[src/agents/auth-profiles/repro_1_4_stress.test.ts](file://src/agents/auth-profiles/repro_1_4_stress.test.ts)` — verifies concurrent refresh failures safely without database locks or snapshot corruption.
  - Original Regression: `[src/agents/auth-profiles/repro_1_4.test.ts](file://src/agents/auth-profiles/repro_1_4.test.ts)`
- Verified that existing related tests (`oauth-refresh-failure.test.ts`, `provider-auth.test.ts`, and `prepare.test.ts`) pass.
- Total of 86 tests passed successfully across the affected surfaces.

### Real Behavior Proof

#### Scenario A — [Attack/Bad Input]: Blocked ✅
Failure to refresh an OAuth credential correctly clears the `lastGood` entry from the snapshot under workspace alias mapping.
Test name: `deletes aliased provider lastGood key on refresh failure when workspace context is provided` in `src/agents/auth-profiles/repro_1_4_edge.test.ts` and `src/agents/auth-profiles/repro_1_4.test.ts`.

Real Vitest output:
```text
 ✓ |agents| src/agents/auth-profiles/repro_1_4_edge.test.ts (2 tests) 422ms
 ✓ |agents| src/agents/auth-profiles/repro_1_4.test.ts (1 test) 191ms
```

#### Scenario B — [Legitimate Input]: Still Allowed ✅
Legitimate refresh under workspace-scoped alias successfully updates the credentials and persists them to the auth store.
Test name: `successfully refreshes token when workspace context is provided` in `src/agents/auth-profiles/repro_1_4_happy.test.ts`.

Real Vitest output:
```text
 ✓ |agents| src/agents/auth-profiles/repro_1_4_happy.test.ts (1 test) 186ms
```

#### Scenario C — [Pre-existing Rejections]: Unaffected ✅
Verifies that when workspace context is missing, the alias resolution fails as expected and does not clear the `lastGood` entry, preserving the legacy fallback behavior.
Test name: `does not resolve alias (and thus fails to clear lastGood key) if workspace context is missing` in `src/agents/auth-profiles/repro_1_4_edge.test.ts`.

Real Vitest output:
```text
 ✓ |agents| src/agents/auth-profiles/repro_1_4_edge.test.ts (2 tests) 422ms
```
